evidence.quoted_text: matches = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith('ExecStart=')]
evidence.reason: Line 465 recognizes an ExecStart directive only when the physical line begins exactly with `ExecStart=`. systemd accepts whitespace around the assignment operator, so `ExecStart = ...` is also an effective directive. If a template contains both spellings, the renderer counts only one, replaces that one, and leaves the spaced command in place; the parallel validation/reporting site described at line 650 shares the same blind spot. This is an implementation defect in the existing requirement to handle exactly one ExecStart directive, not a proposal to add a new requirement.
